records.title: Putting Captions to the Test: Evaluating Video Caption Quality through Multiple-Choice Question Answering
records.reason: The paper evaluates video-caption quality with multiple-choice questions. It is an evaluation protocol for caption quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: LLMs as ASP Programmers: Self-Correction Enables Task-Agnostic Nonmonotonic Reasoning
records.reason: The paper studies LLMs as answer-set-programming coders and self-correction for nonmonotonic reasoning. It evaluates task capability rather than model inference efficiency.

records.title: MedPolicy-KG: A Traceable Clause Logic Graph with Evidence-Tiered Promotion for Chinese Medical Insurance Policy QA
